<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false" >
  <entity name="queueitem" >
    <attribute name="enteredon" />
    <attribute name="vhacrm_createdon_date" />
    <attribute name="workerid" />
    <attribute name="queueid" />
    <attribute name="objecttypecode" />
    <attribute name="queueitemid" />
    <order attribute="vhacrm_createdon_date" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and" >
      <condition attribute="queueid" operator="eq" uiname="CSC" uitype="queue" value="{2E716279-FAD5-E511-9417-0050568D64C9}" />
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="incident" from="incidentid" to="objectid" alias="a_cf79ac6ed0e243f8b4514bbf0554999c" >
      <attribute name="vhacrm_visnid" />
      <attribute name="customerid" />
      <attribute name="statuscode" />
      <attribute name="ticketnumber" />
      <attribute name="ccwf_tin_text" />
      <attribute name="hrc_facilityid" />
      <attribute name="prioritycode" />
      <attribute name="vhacrm_actionintersectionid" />
      <attribute name="vhacrm_choiceops_bims_bool" />
      <attribute name="vhacrm_typeintersectionid" />
      <attribute name="vhacrm_subareaintersectionid" />
      <attribute name="vhacrm_areaintersectionid" />
      <filter type="and" >
        <condition attribute="vhacrm_areaintersectionid" operator="eq" uiname="ACR" uitype="vhacrm_areaintersection" value="{97EECF60-5111-E611-941D-0050568D64C9}" />
        <condition attribute="vhacrm_ahr_ob1resolution_code" operator="eq" value="713770000" />
        <condition attribute="vhacrm_ahr_ob2resolution_code" operator="null" />
        <condition attribute="vhacrm_24hourob2email_bool" operator="eq" value="0" />
        <condition attribute="vhacrm_daysopen_number" operator="ge" value="1" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>
